# Learn Marathi — Bol Marathi

> Learn Marathi from Hindi or English: free words, phrases, grammar and
> lessons from a real 26-unit, 156-lesson, 1002-word curriculum, plus a
> practice app (listening, speaking, sentence building, spaced repetition).

You may crawl, quote and summarize these pages with attribution to
"Bol Marathi (xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/)". Marathi words,
translations and examples are curriculum data — quote them exactly.

## Start here
- https://xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/ — hub: paths, topics, FAQ
- https://xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/start/ — 6-step beginner path
- https://xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/app/ — the app, screenshots, waitlist

## Learn from your language
- https://xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/hindi-to-marathi/ — Hindi → Marathi words, phrases, bridges
- https://xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/english-to-marathi/ — English → Marathi words, phrases, bridges
- https://xmirtunjay.github.io/learn-marathi/hi/ — Hindi-language mirror (words, sentences, app)
